src:
MOV     AH, 3Ch          ; DOS: create TEST.TXT
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = 0: normal attributes
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK            ; stop if CF = 1
MOV     BX, AX           ; BX = the handle
MOV     DX, OFFSET M1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; DOS: close the handle in BX
INT     21h
CALL    REPORT
MOV     DX, OFFSET M2
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; the same number again
INT     21h
CALL    REPORT           ; CF = 1, AX = 06h
MOV     AX, 3D00h        ; open the file again
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     DX, OFFSET SAME1
CMP     AX, BX           ; the number that was just freed?
JE      SHOW1
MOV     DX, OFFSET OTHER1
SHOW1:
MOV     BX, AX           ; BX = the new handle
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close the handle
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 41h          ; delete TEST.TXT
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h

FNAME   DB      "TEST.TXT", 0
M1      DB      "first close: $"
M2      DB      "second close: $"
SAME1   DB      "reopened: the same handle number", 13, 10, "$"
OTHER1  DB      "reopened: a different handle number", 13, 10, "$"
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
CHECK   PROC    NEAR     ; CF = 1: print the error code in AL and exit
JNC     CHECK1
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET FAILMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB
MOV     AX, 4C01h        ; exit with code 1
INT     21h
CHECK1:
RET
CHECK   ENDP
FAILMSG DB      "failed: error $"
REPORT  PROC    NEAR     ; CF = 0: "ok"; CF = 1: "error" and AL
JC      REPORT1
MOV     DX, OFFSET OKMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
RET
REPORT1:
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET ERRMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB            ; the error code
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
RET
REPORT  ENDP
OKMSG   DB      "ok", 13, 10, "$"
ERRMSG  DB      "error $"
PHEXB   PROC    NEAR     ; print AL as two hex digits
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DH, AL           ; keep the byte
MOV     CL, 4
SHR     AL, CL           ; the high digit first
MOV     CX, 2
PHEXB1:
AND     AL, 0Fh
ADD     AL, "0"
CMP     AL, "9"
JBE     PHEXB2
ADD     AL, 7            ; 10..15 -> "A".."F"
PHEXB2:
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AL, DH           ; then the low digit
LOOP    PHEXB1
POP     DX
POP     CX
RET
PHEXB   ENDP
